sections.heading: Find a 24/7 Clinic
body: 24/7 Clinic operates medical clinics inside hotels and resorts across Egypt’s major tourism destinations. Find the nearest clinic or contact our 24/7 coordination team for assistance.

items.title: Filters
items.text: Destination, Hotel, Clinic, Current location if technically possible

items.title: Clinic Card Details
items.text: Hotel name, Destination, Clinic opening hours, WhatsApp CTA, Map / Directions, Medical services available, Insurance accepted, “View Clinic” button

devNotes: The existing list of clinics should remain but be improved.
Avoid generic: “Make an Appointment”. The user is often seeking urgent medical care rather than a scheduled appointment.
